population.allocation: At least one per positive stratum, then largest remainder; individual estimate weight = target segment share / stratum sample count.

sources.title: Cathay Pacific Annual Report 2025 — HK Express operations
sources.supports: Low-cost leisure positioning, Asian destinations and aggregate passenger statistics; not the assumed target-segment weights.

sources.title: Cathay Group December 2025 traffic figures
sources.supports: Aggregate HK Express passenger counts and load factors; no matching membership conversion or segment-share table.

limitations: The reviewed official reports do not publish these customer distributions; all numerical segment weights and budget distributions remain test assumptions.
This is a deliberately targeted audience for flexible bargain travel, not a representative sample of all HK Express passengers. Fixed-date mandatory, urgent and business travel are excluded.
All sampled travellers are already valid members; no membership purchase, renewal, taxes, fuel fees or airline costs enter this experiment.
Each sampled member decides about one personal ticket; companions' purchases are outside this experiment.
Poststratified rates and expected revenue are estimates. Accepted ticket counts and cash revenue remain integer transactions in the cleared panel.
An LLM persona is not an independent observed HK Express customer; repeated choices do not create additional people.

rounds.accounting: Base ticket receipts only; no membership fee, tax, fuel surcharge or operating costs.

I would not pay the higher normal fare if the member quota ran out.

analysis.summary: In this synthetic round, 20 of 32 members accepted the HKD 328 member fare, generating HKD 6,560 in base ticket receipts; 12 declined. All declines cite no offered ticket being both available and within budget (environment-forced), not a stated price objection. No regular-fare purchases occurred. Buyers split between those who would still pay HKD 410 if quota ran out and those who would not. These are stated intentions, not fulfilled purchases, and reasons are explanations rather than measured willingness to pay.
analysis.hypothesis: Among members who accepted HKD 328, the share stating they would still buy at HKD 410 differs from the share who would decline; a later round offering HKD 410 to a comparable member segment can test whether stated fallback intentions predict actual acceptance.

analysis.summary: At a member fare of HKD 293.89, 26 of 32 customers stated intent to buy member tickets, all citing the low fare as the trigger; 6 declined because no offered ticket was both available and within budget. No regular-fare purchases occurred. All buyers were flexible on date or destination, and 13 said they would still pay the HKD 410 regular fare. These are stated intentions, not fulfilled purchases, and reasons are explanations rather than measured willingness to pay.
analysis.hypothesis: Among flexible, destination-agnostic members, raising the member fare above HKD 293.89 will reduce stated member-buy intent, with the drop concentrated among those who declined the HKD 410 regular fallback.

analysis.summary: At a member fare of HKD 293.89, 26 of 32 customers stated intent to buy member tickets, all citing the low fare as the trigger; 6 declined because no offered ticket was both available and within budget. No regular-fare purchases occurred. All buyers were flexible on date or destination, and 13 said they would still pay the HKD 410 regular fare. These are stated intentions, not fulfilled purchases, and reasons are explanations rather than measured willingness to pay.
analysis.hypothesis: Among flexible, destination-agnostic members, raising the member fare above HKD 293.89 will reduce stated member-buy intent, with the drop concentrated among those who declined the HKD 410 regular fallback.

analysis.summary: In this round, 28 of 32 members accepted the HKD 269.54 member fare, generating HKD 7,547.12 in base ticket receipts; 4 declined. All declines cite no offered ticket being both available and within budget, coded as environment-forced rather than a price objection. No inventory denials occurred and quota was not binding. Most buyers describe the fare as a compelling bargain that converts optional leisure browsing into bookings; several say they would also pay the HKD 410 normal fare, while others would decline if the member quota ran out. These are stated intentions, not fulfilled purchases.
analysis.hypothesis: At a member fare near HKD 269.54, members who describe the fare as a compelling bargain will show higher stated purchase intention than those citing budget or availability constraints; a future round testing a higher member fare can check whether stated intention falls.

analysis.summary: At a member fare of HKD 293.89, 26 of 32 customers stated intent to buy member tickets, all citing the low fare as the trigger; 6 declined because no offered ticket was both available and within budget. No regular-fare purchases occurred. All buyers were flexible on date or destination, and 13 said they would still pay the HKD 410 regular fare. These are stated intentions, not fulfilled purchases, and reasons are explanations rather than measured willingness to pay.
analysis.hypothesis: Among flexible, destination-agnostic members, raising the member fare above HKD 293.89 will reduce stated member-buy intent, with the drop concentrated among those who declined the HKD 410 regular fallback.

analysis.summary: At a member fare of HKD 293.89, 26 of 32 customers stated intent to buy member tickets, all citing the low fare as the trigger; 6 declined because no offered ticket was both available and within budget. No regular-fare purchases occurred. All buyers were flexible on date or destination, and 13 said they would still pay the HKD 410 regular fare. These are stated intentions, not fulfilled purchases, and reasons are explanations rather than measured willingness to pay.
analysis.hypothesis: Among flexible, destination-agnostic members, raising the member fare above HKD 293.89 will reduce stated member-buy intent, with the drop concentrated among those who declined the HKD 410 regular fallback.
